description: This file contains utility functions for normalizing JSON schema types to lowercase, normalizing tool schemas, and validating JSON responses against schemas. It is part of the 'litellm_core_utils' module.

methods.name: normalize_json_schema_types
methods.description: Recursively normalizes JSON schema types from uppercase to lowercase.

methods.name: normalize_tool_schema
methods.description: Normalizes a tool definition's parameter schema to use standard JSON Schema lowercase types.

methods.name: validate_schema
methods.description: Validates a JSON response string against a provided JSON schema, raising an error if invalid.
